input: Whisper base.en encoder output (after its final layer_norm), shape (T, 512), 50 states/s
output: states in flan-t5-small encoder space, shape (ceil(T/2), 512); concatenated with the T5-encoded instruction along the sequence axis and passed to the T5 decoder as encoder_hidden_states (order is irrelevant: T5 cross-attention has no position term)
layout: Linear weights are (out, in) and compute x @ W.T + b; Conv1d weight is (out, in, kernel)
ops: x = gelu_erf(conv1d(x, conv.weight, conv.bias, stride=2, padding=1))   # over time, channels-first
h = layer_norm(x, attn_norm, eps); q,k,v = linear(h, q|k|v); split 8 heads of 64; a = softmax(q k^T / sqrt(64)) v (padded keys masked); x = x + linear(merge(a), o)
x = x + linear(gelu_erf(linear(layer_norm(x, ffn_norm, eps), up)), down)
activation: GELU, exact erf form (not the tanh approximation)
norm: LayerNorm with weight and bias, eps=1e-05; pre-norm in every block, one final norm

whisper_window.model: openai/whisper-base.en encoder, including its final layer_norm
whisper_window.samples: 16 kHz mono audio followed by 3 s of zeros, then zero-padded to a multiple of 320 samples (an even number of mel frames)
whisper_window.log_mel: openai/whisper log_mel_spectrogram: n_fft 400, hop 160, Hann window, centred (reflect padding), last frame dropped, power, 80 mel bins, log10 clamp 1e-10, max(x, x.max() - 8), (x + 4) / 4
whisper_window.encoder: conv1 + gelu, conv2 (stride 2) + gelu, add the first T_mel/2 rows of the positional embedding, encoder layers, layer_norm -> (T_mel/2, 512)

t5.use: encoder_hidden_states = concat([t5_encoder(instruction_tokens), bridge(whisper_states)], seq axis); encoder attention mask all ones for both parts; decode greedily with the T5 decoder
